name: paint-the-town
description: Playtest simulator for Paint the Town — a closing-wall territory game on a virtual Chicago.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace engine && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.build:worker: npm run build:data && npm run build --workspace client -- --outDir ../worker/public --emptyOutDir && cp data/board.json worker/public/board.json
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build:worker && npm run deploy --workspace worker
